steps.title: Choose colors and armies
steps.text: Each player selects a color and takes the matching armies.

steps.title: Deal territory cards
steps.text: Shuffle all territory cards and deal them evenly. Each player places 1 army on each territory they receive.

steps.title: Place remaining armies
steps.text: After all territories are claimed, players take turns placing their remaining armies on any owned territories.
Gain armies equal to territories owned ÷ 3 (minimum 3).
Add continent bonuses for any continents you fully control.
Optionally trade in card sets for bonus armies. If you have 5+ cards you must trade a set.
Attack adjacent enemy territories with 2+ armies, rolling dice to resolve battles.
When you conquer a territory, move at least the number of dice you rolled into it.
If you captured at least one territory this turn, take one Risk card at end of attack phase.
Move armies once between two connected territories you own, leaving at least 1 behind.
